## Checklist for data changes

- [ ] `source` points at the official page: the venue, organiser, institution,
      or employer
- [ ] `last_verified` is the date I checked that page
- [ ] Nothing is guessed. Unannounced deadlines and dates use `deadline_tba` or
      `dates_tba` rather than a date carried over from a previous edition
- [ ] The file name matches the `id`
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally, or I am happy to let CI check it
